proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: a map out of j_{p!}F is a compatible family of maps F(V) -> G(V) for V subset U, which by the restriction description of j_p is the same as a map F -> j_pG; sheafification transports the adjunction to sheaves; stalks are read off the definition of the extension; the counits are evaluated on opens of U (source lines 4799-4813)
